newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly weaker, diesel firmer.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly weaker, diesel firmer.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly weaker on Tuesday. Fuel oil sold lower after making initial gains, but diesel premiums firmed after active trade on Tuesday, traders said.
Gasoline weakened as the backwardation in the swaps market, generated by strong buying ahead of the UK budget next week, eased further.
Eurograde barges traded at $181 a tonne fob Antwerp for prompt/first half July material and dealers said a Scandinavian refiner was bidding for refinery barrels at $183 for the same period.
Diesel cargo prices were slightly firmer after a flurry of trade on Tuesday, but heating oil markets were unchanged to slightly softer with supplies good and buyers relaxed.
In ARA prompt lifting storage barges were traded from July IPE -50 cents up to screen evens with a Rotterdam refinery barge taking July IPE +25 cents.
Fuel edged up $1 a tonne in early trading but aggressive selling on prompt barges pulled levels 50 cents back down later.
High sulphur barges traded from $82.50 up to $84 in Rotterdam before easing back when a prompt seller offered back down to $82.75.
